title: Approve a reserved corporate matter
summary: Before a transaction or action that may require board, stockholder, investor or lender consent. A decision record proving which approvals were obtained and which conditions remain before execution.
outcomes: A decision record proving which approvals were obtained and which conditions remain before execution.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: Before a transaction or action that may require board, stockholder, investor or lender consent.

parts.title: Describe the proposed action and commitments
parts.guidance: Prepare the transaction terms, financial exposure, counterparties and intended timing. Identify related documents and previously granted delegations without assuming ordinary purchasing authority covers the action.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Identify the required decision makers
parts.guidance: Have counsel check governing documents, shareholder agreements, financing covenants and applicable rules. Record approval thresholds, conflicts and any notice or meeting requirements for the actual matter.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Assemble the decision materials
parts.guidance: Draft a clear recommendation, alternatives, risks, supporting calculations and proposed resolutions. Keep unresolved terms visible and provide the same final version to the authorized reviewers.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Obtain and record the approvals
parts.guidance: Run the agreed meeting or written-consent process with the required participants. Record recusals, conditions and executed decisions; a favorable discussion alone does not authorize the transaction.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Verify conditions before the execution handoff
parts.guidance: Reconcile each approval with the final transaction and confirm it remains within the approved scope. Hand the evidence to the authorized executor and retain an exception log for changes requiring another decision.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: A decision record proving which approvals were obtained and which conditions remain before execution.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.
